Current official RuneLite evidence inspected for this pass includes Plugin Hub runelite.version 1.12.36, Plugin Hub head e39910dc2f8ec6549b4e30163403a9e667fbd4d5, and example-plugin head 5370caa0f5f6a5bba4fbb42931722ca535ad3fd5. The wiki source was refreshed at commit 5b45ad3e5a6d6e888aa9616b945a3f0968c55fac and publication-proven by Sync GitHub Wiki run 32546455294/job 96965657441 with ProjectDump.wiki.git push, complete fresh-clone byte verification, and Wiki master dbf1db13adbabbe2b92bb4c9ad739ce71e6809b3. The Drive mirror was updated in canonical Project Wikis, independently reread, and exported at 26,380 bytes with SHA-256 5d751083e7b487317631fdc2844f135f851d7e3d571b0b4da7fb25c2be45eca1. PCX-063, PRJ-001, PRJ-002, and PRJ-003 were rechecked without justified source churn.
authorityRule: Prefer current project-owned source/runtime evidence over older summaries. Treat a material wiki update as published when its exact source commit has wiki-publication success or a later full-set Sync GitHub Wiki run includes it and fresh-clone byte verification succeeds. Require durable Drive mirrors for material wiki pages and checkpoints.
